residual_Z6_mixing.anomaly_naturality: The determinant anomaly of the restricted fermion representation is the pullback of its P x U1F anomaly.
residual_Z6_mixing.embedding: Z6 -> P x U1F sends a generator to the order-two matter-parity centre element and the order-three U1F element.
residual_Z6_mixing.important_scope: This does not claim Omega5Spin(B(P x Z6)) vanishes for arbitrary spectra.  It proves that the V46 spectrum inherited from the anomaly-free continuous parent has zero class.

standard_interval_relative_pair.interval_background_homotopy_pullback: B(P x U1F) x^h_{B(Spin10 x U1F)} B(Spin10 x U1F) ~= B(P x U1F)
standard_interval_relative_pair.physical_model: A Spin10 x U1F bulk bundle with a P x U1F reduction at y=0 and no further reduction at the full-Spin10 wall y=L.
standard_interval_relative_pair.scope: This is the standard generalized-homology pair/cofiber model.  No reflection is gauged.  If the orbifold reflection itself is promoted to a microscopic spacetime symmetry, a separate equivariant/Pin bordism problem would have to be specified.
